en: Black-and-white image showing the interior of an early 20th‑century industrial power plant or engine room. Dominating the scene are two large horizontal stationary engines with massive flywheels connected by belts to generators or other machinery. Behind them is a control wall with many round gauges, switches and valves. The room has high ceilings, tiled floor, large multi-pane windows and simple industrial lighting. There is a low metal safety railing around the machines.
